The work of animal scientists falls into four categories: research design and implementation (defining the research question and hypotheses, designing trials with feeding or management treatment groups and controls, collecting data on indicators such as growth, milk yield, egg production, reproduction and health, and controlling the environment and management conditions); laboratory and data analysis (studying animals' nutrient requirements and the nutritional value of feed ingredients, applying genetic principles to measure the genetic composition of populations and the heritability of traits, and carrying out statistics and interpretation and assessing variation and uncertainty); technology transfer and advice (developing improved methods for feeding, housing, hygiene or parasite and disease control, researching and controlling selection and breeding practice to raise production efficiency and improve animal quality, and advising producers on improved products and techniques); and communication and teaching (communicating research results in writing or orally to the scientific community, producers and the public, taking part in peer review and academic exchange, and undertaking teaching and postgraduate supervision and cross-institutional collaboration on joint breeding and technology transfer). Teaching, postgraduate supervision and so on vary with the job; not every researcher has these duties.

items.title: What do employers usually look at in recruitment?

values: Fictional A/B/C paper materials

Material A (fictional design): comparing the average daily gain of feeding regimes A and B over 21 days. There are 6 independent pens, each with 5 simulated animals of the same age, with 3 pens per regime; the pen is the treatment unit. No actual animal trial is arranged in this exercise. The allocation method, initial body weight, consistency of health and environment, blinding and the pre-specified analysis are not given, and they cannot be filled in as already randomized or controlled.

Material B (fictional results): 21-day pen mean daily gain, in kg/animal/day. Regime A pens A1/A2/A3 = 0.60/0.64/0.62; regime B pens B1/B2/B3 = 0.66/0.70/0.68. The 5 animals per pen cannot become 15 independent replicates per group; the material gives only 6 pen means and no individual values, costs, adverse reactions or long-term results.

Material C (a draft promotion text to be reviewed): "B raises the daily gain of all animals by 10%, proving that B is more effective and cheaper and should be promoted immediately." Point out the range the data support and where the text goes beyond it; the fictional data and this sentence must not be treated as real research.
Tasks and reference deliverables

Task 1: write a design points table listing the question, the treatment unit, the number of replicates, the indicator and unit and the control conditions not given; 3 pens each for A and B, and no claim can be made that randomization has been done.

Task 2: retain the 6 original values and calculate the two group means, the difference, the relative difference and the range of each, noting 3 pens per group. Reference recomputation: A mean (0.60+0.64+0.62)/3 = 0.62 and B (0.66+0.70+0.68)/3 = 0.68 kg/animal/day; the difference is 0.06, which relative to A is 0.06/0.62×100% ≈ 9.68%. The pen mean range is 0.04 in both groups, A 0.60—0.64 and B 0.66—0.70. There are 3 independent pens per group; a descriptive difference is not the same as significance or causation.

Task 3: check the four kinds of overreach in C, namely causation, all animals, cost and immediate promotion, and write three conditional recommendation sentences. Reference three sentences: in this fictional 21-day material, the B group pen mean daily gain is 0.68 and A is 0.62, a descriptive difference of 0.06 kg/animal/day, about 9.68%. No randomization, baseline, individual, cost, safety or long-term data are provided, so the conclusions about all animals, causation, being cheaper or promotion are not supported. If real research is intended, the institution should first check the design, sampling unit, ethics and authorization before the study, and feeding or promotion must not be carried out on the basis of paper results.
Independent review method

First check the treatment unit in A and the kg/animal/day in B; by hand the group sums are 1.86 and 2.04, each divided by 3. The denominator for the relative difference is A's 0.62, and 0.06 must not be written as 6%.

Then check that 6 pens are not 30 independent replicates; the randomization, baseline and costs that are not given all remain unknown. Statistical significance cannot be inferred from non-overlapping values.

Finally check C sentence by sentence: about 9.68% is only the difference between two group pen means and cannot show anything about all individuals or causation; cost and safety are not given, so real implementation cannot be recommended.

facts.display_value: Research, production management, disease prevention, quarantine and diagnosis and treatment may involve collaboration, and researchers may also hold other qualifications; the research identity on this page does not itself confer Chinese diagnostic and treatment rights. Actual diagnosis and treatment are carried out according to the respective qualifications, filing, statutory scope and institutional licence of veterinarians, assistant veterinarians and rural veterinarians; there is not only one role.
facts.measure: Research and the boundaries of adjacent duties

facts.display_value: The O*NET survey of education requirements for newly hired workers: 43% doctorate, 22% master's and 13% bachelor's; these are not the education distribution of current staff, a hiring rate or a Chinese threshold. Job Zone5, SVP8.0+ describe extensive preparation; the typical BLS EP entry route is a bachelor's degree, no related work experience and no on-the-job training, and the two bases cannot be combined into a requirement that everyone must have a master's. Some research posts require postgraduate education in addition. Chinese 2-01-07-00 agricultural science researchers covers livestock and poultry and aquaculture, breeding, disease prevention and control, feed formulation and theoretical and technical research in animal husbandry and veterinary medicine, and also covers other agricultural research; this is a related broad category and cannot be described as a one-to-one match with U.S. 19-1011. Chinese posts may fall under different series such as natural science research, agricultural technology or university teaching, and are checked against the unit's post and the current local conditions, with no compulsory uniform master's, doctorate or postdoc. The agricultural technology series has full senior livestock husbandry master and retains the agricultural technology extension researcher; the natural science research series comprises research intern, assistant researcher, associate researcher and researcher. A professional title is not a diagnostic and treatment qualification or a permit to promote new breeds.
facts.measure: Entry and post qualification boundaries
